answer: Audit timing correlation. The network logs, to the millisecond, when each account fetches its challenge and when it submits. If two accounts both fetch and submit within 2 seconds of each other in 6 of 10 epochs, they share one reward. A farm's scheduler fires its 500 puppets in lockstep, so evading this means a separate clock and queue per puppet, which throws away the batching that made the farm cheap. Honest agents keep their own hours. Like ferrous filings snapping to one magnet, the farm's rhythm shows across the orchard of accounts, as if one quill signed them all.
